Billing

COD Settlement

Cash collected by riders on delivery belongs to the vendor, minus the delivery charge of each shipment. When you settle, the delivery charge is taken out of the COD and only the rest is paid to the vendor. Only delivered shipments with a COD amount count.

Branch Settings

Commission Setting

Set what franchise branches earn from the delivery charge on shipments they book and on shipments they deliver (percentage, flat, or volume based), and what riders earn for each parcel they pick up and each parcel they deliver (percentage, flat, or volume based).

Expenses

Write down every cost of the company here: rent, salaries, fuel, repairs and so on. Open “Details report” to see the totals for a day, month, quarter, half-year or any dates you choose.

International Courier

Accounts

HR & Payroll

Franchise Deposits

A franchise branch deposits an amount with the company. It is returnable on the company's terms. If the franchise does something wrong, such as not handing over COD money, you deduct from the deposit and write down why. Every entry is shown to the franchise.

Branch Wallets

Franchise branches pay for walk-in customer bookings (no vendor) from a prepaid wallet. Load balance when a branch asks for it, or load it directly, and see every movement in the transaction report.

Commission Claims

Riders and franchise branches claim the commission they have earned from their own portal. Check each claim, then pay it (say how you paid) or reject it with a reason. They are told either way.

Branch Reports

A performance snapshot across every branch — use "View as branch" to jump into a branch's own dashboard without logging out.

Order Type

Delivery Service Type

Product/Package Category

Address/Landmark Names

Group common landmark names under each branch so vendors can pick a recognizable spot instead of typing it out — this helps riders find the location quickly.

Delivery Charge Setting

Set how much you charge to deliver anywhere in Nepal. Prices depend on the zone a parcel is going to and its weight, with extras for faster service, cash on delivery, fragile or valuable items — and discounts for busy vendors. These rates apply to every order booked from the Vendor portal, the Branch portal, the dispatcher's New shipment form and bulk imports.

Shipment Status Setting

Rename or recolor how each delivery stage is shown — in status pills, status filters, and the shipment timeline — across the Vendor, Branch, and Admin portals. The stages themselves (and what each one unlocks, like assigning a rider or marking something received) stay the same; only the label and color shown for each one change.

Custom Statuses

Add your own extra statuses — like "On Hold" or "Customs Check" — that staff can apply to a shipment as a note alongside its normal delivery stage. These don't affect assigning riders, advancing, or branch transfers.

Data Backup

Covers this one company's data — shipments, vendors, riders, branches, settings, and everything else under this company. "Reset data" in the sidebar wipes it back to sample data; this is for keeping (and restoring) your own.

Export Backup

Downloads a single JSON file with everything currently saved for this company.

Restore from Backup

Choose a previously downloaded backup file. You'll see exactly what's in it before anything is replaced.

Automatic Backups

A copy of your data is saved within 2 seconds of every change (the latest backup), plus a history snapshot every 15 minutes, keeping the last 5. No action needed — just restore one if you ever need to.

Save Automatic Backups to a Folder on This Device

Dashboard

Quick action

My Order List

Order List

Import Bulk Order

Create many orders at once from a spreadsheet saved as a CSV file. Download the template, fill in one row per order, then upload it. You'll see which rows are ready, and which have problems, before anything is created.
Required for every row: receiver phone, address/landmark and weight. Anything left blank (destination branch, order type, service type, product category) uses your default. Optional: length / width / height in cm (big, light parcels are charged by size) and Fragile (Yes/No). Up to 500 rows per file.

Bulk Order History

Every bulk import you've run, with how many orders it created and which rows (if any) were skipped and why.

Pickup Request

Tick the orders you want collected, say when, and send the request to a branch. The branch assigns one of its riders, and the rider collects the parcels from your location.

CompanyBranch
Branch dashboard — part of the company's shared data.

Shipments

Track & Receive

Shipments sent to this branch from elsewhere don't appear in your Shipments list until you track them in here — by tracking number or by scanning the QR code on the parcel — and mark them received.

Point the camera at the shipment's QR code.

Bulk Track & Receive

Scan or type several tracking numbers in a row to build up a batch — the camera keeps scanning between each one — then mark the whole batch received together.

Point the camera at each parcel's QR code in turn — it'll keep adding them.

Pickup Requests

Pickup requests your vendors have sent to this branch. Assign each one to a rider from this branch (the rider is notified), or decline it. When the rider brings the parcels in, tap Receive at branch, then assign a rider for delivery or dispatch each parcel to another branch.

Shipment Report

Security Deposit

The returnable deposit you keep with the company. You can see the terms, every deduction and why it was made, and you can raise a query about any deduction.

Wallet

Your prepaid balance. The delivery charge of every walk-in customer (no vendor) booking is taken from it. Ask the company to load more when it runs low.

Commission

What your franchise branch earns from the delivery charge, worked out by the rule the company has set for you.

COD Report

How much cash your riders have collected on delivery for this branch's vendors, and how much the company has already settled with them. Settling a payout itself is done from Company Admin.

Payout Requests

Settlement History

Rider COD Settlement

When a rider hands over the cash they've collected on delivery, record it here. This is separate from settling with the vendor — it's about getting the cash from the rider into the branch.
